summary: AHDB's final crop condition assessment rated 64% of winter wheat good or excellent, alongside 62% of winter barley, 71% of winter oats and 78% of winter oilseed rape. Prolonged dry conditions in April and May reduced ratings across much of the UK. England saw the greatest drought impact.

title: Crop ratings slip after dry spring, but harvest hope remains
verbatim_quote: According to our final crop condition assessment, 64% of winter wheat was rated good or excellent, alongside 62% of winter barley, 71% of winter oats and 78% of winter oilseed rape (OSR).

summary: Persistent May rainfall across a rain band hundreds of kilometres wide brought up to 400 mm per square metre to numerous central and southern Chinese provinces, bursting more than 100 rivers and causing an estimated US$2.8bn of nationwide losses, only a fraction insured. The East Asian summer monsoon began earlier than usual this year.
